Latin word

imāgō

imāgō, imāginis f.

noun, third declension · Declension on Wiktionary

image, likeness; portrait, likeness (painted, drawn or sculpted); a reflection, an image (in a mirror or water)

    also used · classical · Verg. A. 8.730; Traupman 360

  • reflect

    also used · classical · Varro LL 6.82: speculum, quod in eō specimus imāginem

Examples

  • similem esse tē volō quōmodo fīlium, nōn quōmodo imāginem: imāgō rēs mortua est

    I want you to resemble me as a son does, not as a portrait does: a portrait is a dead thingSen. Ep. 84.8
